{{Quote|I want you to contact a covert operative we have inside the A.C.L.O. office. His name is Mark Hieks.|[[Galiir Ac Yandar]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:II">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Imperial Investigation|Talus}}</ref>}}
'''Mark Hieks''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony]], and later served as a member of the [[Corellian Security Force]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I've been attempting to place sliceware monitoring components on several A.C.L.O. computers. I almost got caught today and had to injure myself to shift the focus away from what I was doing in the wrong place.|Mark Hieks, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MHDCA" />}}
Early during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Mark Hieks was a member of the [[Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization affiliated with the Empire.<ref name="SWG:II" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Mark Hieks was tasked by his superior [[Galiir Ac Yandar]] to infiltrate the [[A.C.L.O. office|headquarters]] of the [[Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization]], a Talusian anti-Imperial organization that disturbed the N.S.H. operations.<ref name="SWG:II" />

[[File:ACLOOffice3.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mark Hieks working undercover in one of the office rooms of the [[A.C.L.O. office]].]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Hieks successfully infiltrated the organization. His job was to plant electronic monitoring devices on four key computer systems. However, Mark had to injure himself to avoid suspicion, rendering him unable to complete the mission himself. Fortunately for him, Galiir sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Braedic Ekirk]] to assist him. The spacer met with Mark Hieks in the A.C.L.O medical bay, and was instructed to place monitoring devices on the A.C.L.O's medical computer, personal computer, operations computer, and equipment manifest computer. The spacer carefully carried out the task successfully, and then reported back to Mark.<ref name="SWG:MHDCA" /> Mark was pleased, but he still had one final task for the spacer to complete. Rebel inspectors were arriving to inspect the local office of the A.C.L.O. The Rebellion was trying to determine whether or not the A.C.L.O should work with them on a more permanent basis. In order to disrupt the inspection, and impede on the A.C.L.O's progress with the Rebellion, Mark tasked the spacer with killing at least ten Rebel inspectors. Once again, the spacer succeeded in his task. Mark was happy with the spacer's skills and dedication to the Empire, yet told the spacer he would have to lay low. Following the completion of the tasks, the spacer returned to Braedic Ekirk, and Mark remained in the A.C.L.O office for a while longer.<ref name="SWG:RI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Rebel Inspectors|Talus}}</ref>

At some point, Hieks became an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] in the employ of the [[Corellian Security Force]]. The [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]] formed a group of Aqualish thugs known as the [[Followers of Baba]] and raided a number of towns on Talus, but CorSec chose not to directly intervene, because they didn't want to make the situation worse, Instead, Hieks hired a spacer to capture Baba, and the individual was successful and handed over the thug to CorSec.<ref name="Followers of Baba" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mark Hieks appeared as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MHDCA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mark Hieks was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Crisis of Allegiance|Crisis of Allegiance]]" arc with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref> In the game, players taking part in the so-called "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" may eventually find themselves in the employ of Mark Hieks. Players are tasked by Mark to plant devices on four A.C.L.O computers,<ref name="SWG:MHDCA" /> and provided that they are Imperial, they may also accept an additional quest to kill ten Rebel inspectors.<ref name="SWG:RI" />
